While the text does not explicitly use the phrase 'GPU-accelerated', the context of ray marching and the specific citation style implies a computational pipeline consistent with the claim's description of enhancing error projection visualization using these specific visual effects.
The pipeline applies a 3×3 Gaussian blur to the image, thresholds intensity values below 1/81st of the maximum value, and adjusts the gamma value to 2.0 to shift mid-tones to brighter values [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the pipeline applies a '3 × 3 Gaussian blur', thresholds 'intensity values below 81-th of the max value' (which is 1/81st), and adjusts the 'gamma value of the image to 2.0 to shift the mid-tones to brighter values'. All specific facts in the claim are present and consistent with the provided text.
